"""Close the existing PASS publication with root's installed-default preparation."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess

R = Path('/home/codex/.codex/worktrees/ec20/Proofs')
L = Path('Logic/Interpretability/ZFCinPA')
P = Path('/tmp/zfc-validator-native-gic-congruence-publication-packet1')
V = Path('/tmp/zfc-validator-native-gic-congruence-maintained-prepared1/verification.json')
PEER = Path('/tmp/zfc-validator-native-gic-congruence-publication-peer/review.json')
O = Path('/tmp/zfc-validator-native-gic-congruence-publication-close1')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
enc = lambda v: (json.dumps(v, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=R)

assert __debug__ and not O.exists() and not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
assert sha(P/'map.json') == '600e60336db10a88e61feb270549d67d8e4d3e30078c979392ff4e9acfccca76'
assert sha(PEER) == '3dd5cc323e03a4b85e0e1752555ba560429c1cea34971badd4d761e91d7600e2'
m = json.loads((P/'map.json').read_bytes())
r = json.loads(V.read_bytes())
assert r['status'] == 'PREPARED_NOT_BUILT' and r['prepare_only']
assert r['commands'] == r['fresh_modules'] == []
assert r['before'] == r['after'] and r['all_input_provider_postchecks']
assert (len(r['before']), len(r['reused_modules']), len(r['providers']), len(r['toolchain_providers']), len(r['actual_first_providers'])) == (84,22,4,2,28)
for path, h in r['before'].items(): assert sha(path) == h, path
original = json.loads((R/L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-verification.json').read_bytes())
for key in ['reused_modules','providers','toolchain_providers','actual_first_providers','compiler','dependencies']:
    assert r[key] == original[key], key
for key in ['source','audit','boundary']:
    assert r[key]['sha256'] == original[key]['sha256']
    assert Path(r[key]['path']).is_relative_to(R)
assert r['source']['path'] == str(R/L/'Lean/ZFCinPA/ValidatorNativeGicCongruence254.lean')
assert r['audit']['path'] == str(R/L/'validator_native_gic_congruence254_audit.lean')
assert r['boundary']['path'] == str(R/L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-boundary.json')
note = L/'validator_native_gic_congruence254.md'
paths = [Path(item['target']) for item in m['files']]
for item in m['files']:
    assert sha(item['source']) == item['sha256']
    if Path(item['target']) != note: assert sha(R/item['target']) == item['sha256']
history = json.loads((R/L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-history.json').read_bytes())
assert len(history['aliases']) == 36 and len(history['text_by_sha256']) == 32
for alias, row in history['aliases'].items():
    assert history['text_by_sha256'][row['sha256']].encode() == Path(alias).read_bytes()
additions = {
    L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-maintained-preparation.json': V.read_bytes(),
    L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-publication-peer.json': PEER.read_bytes(),
}
for path in additions: assert not (R/path).exists()
O.mkdir()
for path, raw in additions.items(): (R/path).write_bytes(raw)
paths += list(additions)
paths += [Path('Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/pa_internalization.md')]
receipt = {
    'status': 'ROOT_INSTALLATION_AND_MAINTAINED_DEFAULT_PREPARATION_PASS',
    'packet': {'path': str(P/'map.json'), 'sha256': sha(P/'map.json')},
    'actual_proof': {'sha256': sha(R/L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-verification.json'), 'probes': 8, 'callers': 11, 'warnings': 0},
    'maintained_preparation': {'path': str(V), 'sha256': sha(V), 'commands': [], 'fresh_modules': [], 'inputs': 84, 'providers': {'projects':22, 'external':4, 'tools':2}},
    'note_update': 'Only the publication-status paragraphs changed after the actual installed-default preparation. Original proposed note remains in lossless history.',
    'files': {str(path): sha(R/path) for path in paths},
    'source_audit_boundary_unchanged': True,
    'history_aliases_roundtripped': 36,
    'scope': 'Publishes prior actual fixed-label congruence proof; no additional Lean run, whole-cache attestation, full R2 or PA endpoint.',
    'root_script': {'path': __file__, 'sha256': sha(__file__), 'text': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
installed = L/'results/validator-native-gic-congruence254-installation.json'
assert not (R/installed).exists()
(R/installed).write_bytes(enc(receipt)); paths.append(installed)
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', (R/note).read_text()):
    if '://' not in target: assert (R/note.parent/target.split('#')[0]).exists(), target
subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '--', *map(str, paths)], cwd=R, check=True)
assert set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only','-z').decode().strip('\0').split('\0')) == set(map(str,paths))
for path in paths: assert git('show', ':'+str(path)) == (R/path).read_bytes()
(O/'installation.json').write_bytes(enc(receipt))
print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'files_staged':len(paths), 'inputs':84, 'proof_repeated':False}))
